features: Fixes the mobile Live Screen control URL so it preserves the configured BDC application base path such as /BDC_STAGING/
Replaces the fragile relative control.php mobile link with the application url() helper generated admin/live-screen/control.php route
Prevents mobile Open Projector Controls from resolving against an incorrect browser path and opening an unrelated blank or black page
Uses the same absolute application-aware control route for desktop embedded controls
Keeps projector session, remote feed, scoring, results and official BDC points logic unchanged
No Staging or Production deployment performed
